title: Pet Addendum Schedule of One-Time Fees and Pet Deposits
content:
# Schedule of one-time fees and pet deposits — Pet Addendum

The one-time amounts attached to a Pet Addendum are fixed by addendum type. The schedule below states, for every addendum type, whether fees apply at all, the one-time pet fee, whether that fee is refundable, the pet deposit, the waste DNA registration fee and the move-out flea treatment charge. All amounts are in US dollars.

| Addendum type | Fees apply | One-time pet fee | Pet fee refundable | Pet deposit | Waste DNA registration fee | Move-out flea treatment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assistance Animal Accommodation | No | 0.00 | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Caged Pet Addendum | Yes | 150.00 | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cat Addendum | Yes | 300.00 | No | 250.00 | 0.00 | 85.00 |
| Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | Yes | 350.00 | No | 300.00 | 45.00 | 85.00 |
| Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | Yes | 400.00 | No | 300.00 | 45.00 | 95.00 |
| Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) | Yes | 450.00 | No | 400.00 | 45.00 | 110.00 |

## What each column means

- **Fees apply** — whether pet fees, the pet deposit and pet rent apply to the addendum type at all. The column reads "No" only for the Assistance Animal Accommodation.
- **One-time pet fee** — the non-refundable pet fee charged at approval.
- **Pet fee refundable** — whether the one-time pet fee is refundable. It is not refundable under any addendum type.
- **Pet deposit** — the refundable pet deposit, added to the household's security deposit account at approval.
- **Waste DNA registration fee** — the one-time fee for registering a waste DNA sample.
- **Move-out flea treatment** — the flea treatment charge at move-out for a household with a dog or cat.

## Reading the schedule

**Which addendum types carry a pet deposit?** The Cat Addendum and the three dog addenda. The Caged Pet Addendum and the Assistance Animal Accommodation show a pet deposit of 0.00.

**Is the pet deposit the same kind of money as the one-time pet fee?** No. The schedule describes the pet deposit as refundable and held in the security deposit account; the one-time pet fee is described as non-refundable for every addendum type.

**Which addendum types show a nonzero waste DNA registration fee?** The Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb), the Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) and the Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb), each at 45.00.

**Does the flea treatment charge rise with the size of the dog?** On this schedule it does: 85.00 for the Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb), 95.00 for the Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) and 110.00 for the Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb). The Cat Addendum also shows 85.00.
